principles: The shell never executes arbitrary commands or manifest-provided shell strings.
Intent actions are limited to a reviewed local allowlist and require explicit approval.
Unconfigured capabilities default to denied in the shell preference profile.
File inspection and hashing run locally; uploads are not performed by the shell.
A UI control is not evidence that a kernel, driver, updater, model or runtime is connected.
Hardware inventory must label its source and distinguish native operating-system evidence from browser-only estimates.
Driver installation is limited to exact, signed, operating-system-managed packages with a backup, recovery path and explicit approval.
Firmware inventory is read-only; universal BIOS, EC or VBIOS flashing and arbitrary register writes are not safe defaults.

desktop.scope: browser shell, responsive layout, draggable windows, dock, seven original app panels, six existing system tools and Hardware Studio

intent_ui.scope: offline allowlisted actions, preview and explicit confirmation

local_ai_and_npu.scope: no local model runtime, NPU enumeration or kernel scheduling

approval_zones.scope: Mora intent actions only; system-level approvals require native broker

immutable_updates.scope: shell settings snapshot only; no atomic OS image updater

app_sandboxing.scope: policy documented; browser prototype does not sandbox native processes

zero_trust_permissions.scope: deny-by-default shell preferences; no kernel enforcement

provenance.scope: local SHA-256; C2PA signature and manifest verification absent

adaptive_workspace.scope: responsive browser layout, persisted light/dark palette and reduced motion; native XR session transfer remains absent

multimodal_input.scope: keyboard, pointer and touch; no voice or spatial input service

material_interface.scope: Mora glass surfaces, explicit borders, motion and contrast states

compatibility.scope: PE/ELF header inspection only; no Win32, DirectX, Vulkan or anti-cheat runtime

declarative_configuration.scope: versioned local shell preferences; no full OS desired-state manager

accessibility.scope: reduced-motion controls and responsive layout; more contrast and assistive profiles remain

energy_awareness.scope: user-selectable shell preference only; no CPU/GPU power scheduler or VRR control

shared_design_system.scope: shared semantic palette and theme tokens in the Mora browser shell; native adapters remain distinct

installable_workspace.scope: web manifest and scoped offline cache; not an OS installer

hardware_inventory.scope: native Windows CIM/PnP and Linux sysfs/procfs snapshot agent; macOS device inventory is not implemented

driver_store_backup.scope: Windows pnputil Driver Store export with a SHA-256 manifest; no binary patching

driver_update_discovery.scope: Windows Update driver offer scanning and explicit Microsoft Update Catalog lookups; OEM sources require exact vendor evidence

driver_update_install.scope: one exact Windows Update driver ID with confirmation, Driver Store export, System Restore checkpoint and previously accepted EULA

firmware_access.scope: read-only BIOS/UEFI/DMI/Secure Boot/TPM information; firmware flashing is not implemented

gaming_telemetry.scope: browser frame pacing probe and local game profiles; native ETW/PresentMon/GPU vendor telemetry is not connected
